rules.decision: invalid -> unfitted reference -> low -> edge -> outside fit -> generic -> ambiguous gap -> strong quality -> open-like/short-like

label_meanings.OPEN_LIKE: isolated strong positive return, consistent with tested open end; not unique proof of an open circuit
label_meanings.SHORT_LIKE: isolated strong negative return, consistent with tested short cap; not unique proof of a short circuit
label_meanings.POSITIVE_RETURN: positive non-strong residual; not a calibrated impedance value
label_meanings.NEGATIVE_RETURN: negative non-strong residual; not a calibrated impedance value
label_meanings.AMBIGUOUS_RETURN: amplitude gap, excessive magnitude or nonisolated strong return; no terminal-fault label

limitations: Single15m endpoint session and historical B/D controls selected this development rule. Amplitude windows/peak-isolation rules are engineering hypotheses, not calibrated Gamma or statistical guarantees. Prospective endpoints at5m and prospective weak controls must be evaluated without retuning this version. Same-PCB normal reference unavailable. A27/C470/E2K are not independent validation of this classifier.
